> 十三章 元宵（第1页）
用力拉起紫茉，蓝若晴问道：“紫茉，告诉我，今年的年号是什么？是不是伟祺十七年？”
“小姐，你怎么了啊？今年是伟祺十七年啊，正月十五，元宵节。”不放心的，把手放在蓝若晴的额头上摸了下，然后摇摇头说：“不热呀，怎么了呢？难道还是没睡醒在睡梦中呢吗？”
说完，紫茉转身从衣柜中拿出一套白色丝绸外罩白纱的衣服，“小姐，这套衣服是你年前指定巧手张做的，上午刚刚取回来，你说要在元宵节穿上，映着红灯会更好看，换上衣服我们快去听雨阁吧，去晚了，老爷该怪罪了。”
听雨阁？这个元宵节的宴会在听雨阁，有很多官员的夫人都来将军府，男人们在正气堂由将军蓝烨磊招待，女眷们则聚在听雨阁。
“紫茉，现在是什么时辰？”蓝若晴迅速的换上紫茉递来的衣服，急急的问。
在蓝若晴的记忆，母亲是在酉时被诬与人通奸的。
姨娘沈傲珊带着很多官员的女眷到母亲住的清风阁，将母亲沈沛珊与辰一诺抓奸在床，从此，母亲彻底的沦为下堂妻，蓝烨磊更是不再去清风阁。
“不行！我要阻止悲剧的发生！”蓝若晴恨恨的说：“我不会让她们母女得逞，凌驾于我与母亲之上！”
“小姐，头发有点乱了，我帮您重新梳一下，再补下妆。”紫茉说着，走向梳妆台。“唉……小姐，你这是要去哪啊？小姐……”
蓝若晴已听不到紫茉的喊声，穿好衣服，蓝若晴冲出房门，要在沈傲珊去清风阁之前赶到，阻止悲剧的发生。
前一世，姨娘沈傲珊与蓝汐冷伤害了她与她的母亲，使得她们母女失去了属于自己的幸福，此生，蓝若晴必不会再任由她们兴风作浪。
“上一世她们母女送给我的，这一世，我定要连本带利的还给她们。”蓝若晴在心中如是的想着。
府内的一切景物都是如此熟悉，虽然这里对于蓝若晴来说已经是六年前的将军府，可是这里的一草一木，都在若晴的心里。
出了院门左转，蓝若晴听见紫茉在身后追喊她的声音。
“不！我不能停止脚步！一刻的停止，都有可能引起悲剧的再次重演。”蓝若晴在心中告诉自己，更是加快了脚步。
当年，沈傲珊与蓝汐冷的陷害，不止是使蓝若晴失去了父亲的宠爱，更是令她无法接受母亲不忠背叛父亲的事实。
从此以后，蓝若晴一直以有这样的母亲而感到羞耻，不再去清风阁见沈沛珊。
一年后，沈沛珊因终年郁郁寡欢，而香消玉殒，那一年，蓝若晴未满十三岁。

沈沛珊的一生，都是为了蓝若晴而活。
蓝若晴诗词歌赋，琴棋书画如此出众，也皆因她的母亲教导有方。
沈沛珊去世后，蓝烨磊悲伤了很久，几个月以来，一直一个人独住在清风阁，没有再去沈傲珊的房间。

The latest chapter of The Reborn Daughter Wushuang_Chapter 13 Lantern Festival Page 1_The Reborn Daughter Wushuang Ruffian Snow_Hot Novel Network
> Chapter Thirteen Lantern Festival (Page 1)
Pulling Zimao up hard, Lan Ruoqing asked: "Zimo, tell me, what is the year of this year? Is it the seventeenth year of Weiqi?"
"Miss, what's wrong with you? This year is the seventeenth year of Wei Qi, the fifteenth day of the first lunar month, the Lantern Festival." Uneasy, she put her hand on Lan Ruoqing's forehead and touched it, then shook her head and said, "It's not hot, what's wrong? Are you still awake from your sleep?"
After saying that, Zi Mo turned around and took out a set of white silk clothes covered with white gauze from the wardrobe, "Miss, this set of clothes was made by your skilled craftsman years ago. I just got it back this morning. You said you would wear it during the Lantern Festival. It will look better under the red light. Let's change clothes and go to Tingyu Pavilion quickly. I'm late and I should blame the master."
Tingyu Pavilion? This Lantern Festival banquet was held in Tingyu Pavilion. Many wives of officials came to the general's mansion. The men were entertained by General Lan Yelei in Zhengqi Hall, while the female relatives gathered in Tingyu Pavilion.
"Zimo, what time is it now?" Lan Ruoqing quickly put on the clothes Zimo handed over and asked urgently.
In Lan Ruoqing's memory, her mother was falsely accused of adultery in Youshi.
Aunt Shen Aoshan brought many of the officials' female relatives to Qingfeng Pavilion where her mother lived, and caught her mother Shen Peishan and Chen Yinuo in bed and raped her. From then on, her mother was completely reduced to a concubine, and Lan Yilei no longer went to Qingfeng Pavilion.
"No! I want to prevent the tragedy from happening!" Lan Ruoqing said bitterly: "I will not let their mother and daughter succeed and put themselves above my mother and me!"
"Miss, your hair is a little messy. Let me help you comb it again and put on your makeup." Zi Mo said, walking towards the dressing table. "Oh... Miss, where are you going? Miss..."
Lan Ruoqing could no longer hear Zi Mo's shouting. After putting on her clothes, Lan Ruoqing rushed out of the room to arrive before Shen Aoshan went to Qingfeng Pavilion to prevent the tragedy.
In the previous life, her aunt Shen Aoshan and Lan Xileng hurt her and her mother, causing them to lose their own happiness. In this life, Lan Ruoqing will never let them make trouble again.
"My mother and daughter gave it to me in the last life. In this life, I will definitely return it to them with interest." Lan Ruoqing thought in her heart.
Everything in the mansion is so familiar. Although this is the General's mansion six years ago for Lan Ruoqing, every plant and tree here is in Ruoqing's heart.
After exiting the courtyard and turning left, Lan Ruoqing heard Zi Mo's voice calling her from behind.
"No! I can't stop! If I stop for a moment, the tragedy may happen again." Lan Ruoqing told herself in her heart, and even accelerated her pace.
Back then, the frame-up between Shen Aoshan and Lan Xileng not only caused Lan Ruoqing to lose her father's favor, but also made her unable to accept the fact that her mother had been unfaithful and betrayed her father.
From then on, Lan Ruoqing felt ashamed of having such a mother and no longer went to Qingfeng Pavilion to see Shen Peishan.
A year later, Shen Peishan died due to depression all year round. That year, Lan Ruoqing was not yet thirteen years old.
Shen Peishan's whole life has been lived for Lan Ruoqing.
Lan Ruoqing's poetry, poetry, music, chess, calligraphy and painting are so outstanding, all because of her mother's good teaching.
After Shen Peishan passed away, Lan Yelei was sad for a long time. For several months, he lived alone in Qingfeng Pavilion and never went to Shen Aoshan's room again.
